interview.name: Quinn
interview.answer: The repair drive is on Sunday at the community center.

reflections: Quinn is a highly responsive and proactive helper who follows through on requests quickly.
Opal and Gus are coordinating the repair drive by routing practical needs through Quinn.
The group is focused on mobilizing community support with clear asks: publicity, volunteers, tools, skills, and small repairs.
Quinn is the primary coordinator and relays updates, showing a pattern of dependable follow-through for the repair drive.
Sam tends to handle logistics and inventory, focusing on checking donated items and identifying missing tools.
Faye is coordinating around family schedule constraints and needs final timing before committing.
Quinn is coordinating the repair drive and keeping communication active across volunteers, tools, and timing.
Sam is helping with logistics by organizing the list and separating missing tools, while Eli is handling schedule timing.
Faye and Kira mainly want confirmation and timing details so they can fit the event around pickup/drop-off and know it is still on.
Quinn is the coordination hub, repeatedly relaying updates and keeping the repair drive organized.
The group is working around a shared schedule constraint, with times, pickup, and drop-off details still being finalized.
Several people are relying on Quinn to broadcast information quickly and help reduce stress as plans solidify.
Quinn is a highly responsive coordinator who repeatedly offers to spread updates, gather volunteers, and help with setup.
The group relies on Quinn as a communication hub, with multiple people asking him to relay times, locations, and logistics.
The repair drive planning is collaborative but still dependent on final timing and drop-off details to reduce stress and keep it organized.
